newsitem.title: UK: LucasVarity down on stock overhang.
newsitem.headline: LucasVarity down on stock overhang.

text.p: Shares in systems manufacturer LucasVarity dropped in a rising market on Thursday, hit by an overhang of stock after a placing of three million shares on Wednesday, traders said.
By 0940 GMT the stock was down 7-1/2p or 3.46 percent at 210p on volume of 1.5 million.
"There was a bit of stock washing around yesterday and it's probably a knock-on from that," one market-maker said.
Traders said an overhang from the placing had depressed the share price. "If that didn't all get placed that might be the reason they're down," another market-maker said.
LucasVarity shares have drifted downwards since peaking at 262p in early December 1996.
